hadith:
Bathing (Ghusl) - Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:

`Umar bin Al-Khattab told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "I became Junub at night." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Perform ablution after washing your private parts and then sleep."
message: Remember that Allah, Al Maajid (The Glorious), commands our reverence and obedience through His majesty and honor—maintaining purity of body and soul through proper ablution and righteous conduct is a means of drawing closer to His greatness. Reflect upon the consequences described in the Quran for those who turn away from His guidance, and let this serve as motivation to uphold your faith and fulfill your religious obligations with sincerity.
name:
Al Maajid - الْمَاجِدُ - The Glorious

The name Al Maajid emphasizes the glory and majesty of Allah. It highlights His honor and the reverence He commands in the hearts of believers. The origin of this name comes from the Arabic root related to honor and magnificence, reflecting the Islamic belief in Allah's supremacy and grandeur in all aspects of existence.
verse:
Ibrahim - Abraham - 14:16-17

Awaiting them is Hell, and they will be left to drink oozing pus, which they will sip with difficulty, and can hardly swallow. Death will overwhelm them from every side, yet they will not ˹be able to˺ die. Awaiting them still is harsher torment.
